_note: Names MintFace wrote down beside an address, and the handle each collector goes by. This is the top of the precedence order: it outranks a self-set name and outranks ENS. See docs/NAMES.md and api/_lib/names.js. Not to be confused with collector-names.json, which is the ENS forward-resolution seed list ... that one records a name the chain knows only from the other end, this one records a name the chain does not know at all. Address-keyed, because a name and a handle are properties of a person rather than of a work: the old path wrote display_name onto every record somebody held, which said one fact as many times as they owned things and lost it on any record a sweep rebuilt. Names lowercase per the register convention; handles keep the case their owner writes them in. The slug never follows the name ... URLs stay address-canonical.
